genre: Cheap late-evening comedy panel show host (the dishevelled comic)
where_when: A small, slightly tatty TV studio during a late-evening taping: host's desk on a riser, two blank-fronted contestant desks either side, a studio audience in the dark beyond
camera: Modern HD studio pedestal camera, straight-on medium close-up at eye level, tight headroom
light: Hot white top light on the host, magenta and amber uplighters glowing under the desk fronts, audience falling off into shadow
wardrobe: Crumpled black suit jacket, white shirt half untucked, collar skew, thin black tie yanked loose
gloves: Logo patch on the back; thin black leather dress gloves
doing: Topping up his glass of red wine from a bottle hidden under the desk, still pointing at the camera with the other hand, the wine already running over the rim onto his cue cards
presenter_tells: Hand-held blank cue cards, clip-on lapel mic, host's desk with blank buzzer, studio audience silhouettes and a camera pedestal edge in frame

genre: Deadpan roving street reporter (comedy of absurd escalation)
where_when: A wet provincial high street outside a small bank with its metal shutters pulled down, grey mid-afternoon drizzle, a few ordinary shoppers with bags
camera: 2000s shoulder-mounted standard-definition news camcorder, slightly soft, a little video smear on highlights
light: Flat overcast daylight plus a harsh on-camera top light catching the drizzle in front of the lens
wardrobe: Oversized beige trench coat buttoned to the throat, chunky brown roll-neck under it, a long scarf whipping in the wind
gloves: Plain; brown knitted woollen gloves with full fingers
doing: Solemnly holding an enormous mic with a giant foam windshield down to a pigeon pecking at the closed cash-machine slot, waiting for its answer with total seriousness
presenter_tells: Oversized hand mic with a plain square mic cube, standing square to camera in a piece-to-camera, curly earpiece wire down the collar, a passer-by cropped at frame edge staring at him

where_when: A cramped 1980s regional studio at 6 a.m.: a large blue chroma wall with soft abstract weather blobs, a desk fan on a stand just out of shot
camera: 1980s tube studio camera, warm colour, comet-tail smears off bright highlights, slightly bloomed
light: Flat bright fluorescent key from the front, a hard rim light from behind
wardrobe: Boxy double-breasted cream blazer with shoulder pads over a dark brown polo neck, wide trousers
doing: Sweeping one arm across the map with a clicker while the umbrella he is demonstrating in the other hand has just blown inside out in the studio fan
presenter_tells: Standing side-on to the map wall with an arm sweep, clicker in hand, square-on head turned to the lens, floor tape marks and a light stand at frame edge

where_when: A warm living-room style set on a 24-hour shopping channel in the small hours: beige sofa, potted plant, a turntable plinth with a product on it
camera: Ceiling-mounted robotic studio camera, flat clean HD, slightly high angle
light: Big, even, warm soft-box light from both sides, no shadows, cosy and over-bright
wardrobe: Oatmeal cardigan over a pale blue shirt buttoned up, neat slacks
gloves: Logo patch on the back; smooth white satin evening gloves
doing: Holding a shiny gold piggy bank at chest height like a luxury item and shaking it hard by his ear to prove it is completely empty
presenter_tells: Product held at chest toward the lens, rotating turntable plinth, a plain coloured price-banner panel across the lower quarter of the frame, a lapel mic on the cardigan

genre: Nature documentary presenter in the field
where_when: Tall wet grass on a misty heath at dawn, with an abandoned bank safe lying on its side half hidden in the bracken
camera: 16mm film camera on a long telephoto lens, visible grain, shallow focus, slight gate weave
light: Low golden dawn sun from behind, mist glowing, cool shadows
wardrobe: Khaki safari shirt with rolled sleeves over a long-sleeved base layer, many-pocketed gilet, radio mic pack clipped to the belt
doing: Crouched low and creeping toward the safe as if it were a rare and dangerous animal, one finger raised to the camera for silence, binoculars swinging off his neck
presenter_tells: Crouched piece-to-camera with head and shoulders squared to the lens, pointing hand toward the subject, radio mic pack and lavalier wire, a boom pole edge poking into frame

where_when: The touchline of a small muddy football ground on a rainy weeknight, floodlights, a thin crowd as soft dots in the stand behind
camera: Broadcast camera with a big box zoom lens from further down the touchline, telephoto compression, raindrops on the lens hood
light: Hard white floodlights from high up, cold rain streaks caught in the beams
wardrobe: Long padded touchline coat zipped to the chin, a plain two-colour striped scarf, wellington boots
gloves: Logo patch on the back; padded black goalkeeper gloves
doing: Delivering his serious tactical verdict to camera while a pitch sprinkler behind him swings round and soaks him from the side, mic flag dripping
presenter_tells: Stick mic with a plain square station flag held at chin height, waist-up framing square to camera, earpiece wire, the stadium bowl and floodlights behind

where_when: A loud primary-colour studio set of painted flats and giant foam shapes, mid-morning live show, kids' cushions on the floor
camera: 1990s studio video camera recorded to tape, saturated colours bleeding slightly, soft scan lines
light: Bright flat high-key studio light, coloured gels splashing the back flats
wardrobe: Baggy patterned shell-suit top in clashing colours, zipped to the chin, dungarees over it
gloves: Plain; chunky white cartoon-style cotton gloves
doing: Kneeling at a child's height operating a large felt piggy-bank puppet that is coughing out a shower of blank confetti, his other arm flung wide in delight
presenter_tells: Kneeling, arm open toward the lens, head-mic on a thin wire along the cheek of the hood, felt puppet, studio cameras and a floor manager's arm just in frame

where_when: A 1950s live studio: painted flat backdrop of a sitting room, a sponsor's product on a pedestal, a big ribbon microphone on a stand, a boom mic overhead
camera: 1950s black-and-white kinescope frame grab, soft contrast, fine grain, slight halation
light: Hard fresnel spotlights, crisp shadows on the flat behind him
wardrobe: Sharp 1950s double-breasted suit, pocket square, high starched collar, tie pin
gloves: Logo patch on the back; short white kid-leather dress gloves
doing: Proudly presenting the sponsor's shiny new toaster on its pedestal while it pours smoke and a flame licks out of one slot, his other hand still held out in a salesman's flourish
presenter_tells: Ribbon microphone on a stand, boom mic dipping into frame, product pedestal, a pedestal camera and its operator's shoulder at the edge

where_when: A dark election studio at 3 a.m.: a huge wall of plain coloured result blocks, and a big physical swingometer on a stand
camera: Steadicam on a wide 24mm lens, swooping in low and close, slight motion blur
light: Coloured glow from the result wall, hard cyan and orange spill, deep black studio behind
wardrobe: White shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, loosened tie, waistcoat, pencil behind the ear of the hood
doing: Has just given the swingometer arrow a flick and it is spinning round and round out of control while he points at it to camera with his other hand as if this is the result
presenter_tells: Pointing hand and pointer stick, coloured results wall behind, earpiece wire, lapel mic on the waistcoat, squared stance to the lens

where_when: A bright daytime TV kitchen set with a marble island, a window with fake garden behind, copper pans hanging, steam rising
camera: Jib-arm camera high and angled down over the island at 45 degrees
light: Soft daylight from the window plus warm pendant lamps over the island
wardrobe: Striped apron over a crisp blue chef's jacket, a tea towel over the shoulder
gloves: Logo patch on the back; quilted oven gloves
doing: Lifting the cloche off his showpiece cake with a flourish just as the whole sponge sinks and collapses into the middle
presenter_tells: Island counter between him and the lens, a raised wooden spoon mid-explanation, lapel mic on the apron strap, a floor monitor and studio light visible at frame edge

where_when: A big stage at midnight during a charity telethon: rows of phone-bank volunteers at tables behind him, a giant totaliser board of blank flip panels
camera: Modern smartphone photo from the audience floor, slightly tilted, mixed light, a bit of noise
light: Warm stage spots on him, cold blue light on the phone bank, coloured sweeps from moving heads
hood: multicolour granny-square crochet (orange, teal and cream squares)
wardrobe: Sequinned dinner jacket, bow tie undone and hanging, a giant charity ribbon pinned on
doing: Rattling a collection bucket upside down at the camera to show nothing falls out, while every phone volunteer behind him has fallen asleep on the table
presenter_tells: Hand mic held high, collection bucket, the phone bank and totaliser board behind, square address to the lens on a stage

genre: Latin American Saturday variety show host
where_when: A huge, packed live variety studio on a Saturday afternoon: a cheering audience on tiered seats close behind, dancers in feathers, a confetti cannon
camera: 1990s broadcast camera on a dolly caught mid-crash-zoom, slight zoom blur at the edges
light: Hot mixed stage lighting, chaser bulbs around the set, strong colour
wardrobe: Loud glossy white suit with gold buttons and very wide lapels, open-collar shirt
gloves: Logo patch on the back; shiny gold vinyl gloves
doing: Leading the whole audience in the sponsor's jingle with the mic held high, while a confetti cannon fires straight into the side of his head
presenter_tells: Hand mic with a plain triangular mic flag held up high, packed audience behind, chaser-light set, arm thrown wide toward the lens
